messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity and the damping coefficient. Coefficient values are determined by the fluid viscosity and the shape of the pendulum. Pendulum models must include viscous damping whenever the swing occurs within a fluid medium. Medium resistance produces amplitude decay that is essential to capture for accurate real-world predictions. Predictions for ideal vacuum conditions do not require this damping term.
